BETA Close X CRH plc announced on March 18, 2026, that it acquired 9,033 of its ordinary shares on March 17, 2026, through its broker, Wells Fargo Securities, LLC, as part of its share buyback program. The total value of these repurchased shares was approximately $943,000, with an aggregated volume-weighted average price of $104.3559 per share. These acquired shares will be cancelled, and following these transactions, CRH will have 669,063,805 ordinary shares in issue, with 35,643,874 shares held in treasury, representing 5.058% of the issued share capital. This buyback is part of CRH's intention to repurchase up to $300 million in shares by April 28, 2026. The ordinary shares acquired (by way of redemption) will be cancelled.
